# Divisible-Sandpile-RWRS

A Lean 4 formalization of *Divisible sandpiles via random walks in random
scenery* (Bou-Rabee, Peres, Sava-Huss, [arXiv:2604.13968](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.13968)).

The paper's statements are frozen between `FROZEN-STATEMENT` markers, pinned by
hash in `ledger/manifest.yaml`, and proved against the pinned source in
`paper/rwrs.tex`.  Shared lattice objects come from
[Lattice-Probability](https://github.com/nitromannitol/Lattice-Probability).

## Build

```sh
lake exe cache get
lake build
```

The shared library `lattice-probability` is declared in `lakefile.lean`.
The certificate records the toolchain, dependency revision, and paper hash.

The verification gates run in this order:

```sh
python3 tools/check_manifest.py
python3 tools/check_axioms.py
python3 tools/check_warnings.py
python3 tools/check_constants.py
python3 tools/sync_docs.py --write
python3 tools/check_coverage.py
python3 tools/certificate.py
python3 tools/certificate.py --check
```

`CORRESPONDENCE.md` lists the external propositions and proved witnesses.
In particular, the Carne–Varopoulos input is the pointwise transition bound;
rooted polynomial volume growth supplies the polynomial-radius exit estimates
used in stabilization part (ii).
